title: Conceptual engineering using large language models
reasoning: The paper focuses on the philosophical methodology of conceptual engineering, using LLMs as a tool to implement and evaluate classification procedures for concepts. While it uses Sally Haslanger's feminist ameliorative analysis of 'WOMAN' as a primary case study—which involves social justice and systematic subordination—the paper's objective is to explore the methodology of conceptual engineering rather than to evaluate or benchmark religious beliefs, spiritual traditions, or ethical frameworks themselves.
